## Episode Thesis

This was a geopolitical episode, not a market one. Ukraine's ambassador to Sweden, Svetlana Salisjuk, said Russia is escalating attacks on civilian energy infrastructure ahead of a hard winter, while Ukraine holds the front line. She also said EU sanctions and Sweden's seizures of Russia's shadow fleet are working. Entrepreneur Marcus Gustafsson urged Swedish companies, especially small ones, to see Ukraine as Europe's main front for innovation and to form joint ventures. Swedish companies with Ukraine operations came up only in passing, and nobody gave a view on any stock.
